mechanism: CALL the engine's own FUObjectItem::SetRootFlags / ClearRootFlags (derived, see rootpath-derivation.json). GRoots registration, the RootSet bit and the reachability barrier all happen inside the engine; the runtime reimplements none of them.

addresses.verification: both byte-verified live==disk immediately before use

gc_evidence.why_not_a_timeout_argument: While the asset was rooted, the FUObjectItem's reachability bits were observed CYCLING through all three values (0x40000001 / 0x40000002 / 0x40000004 alongside the constant 0x40000000 RootSet). UE 5.4 alternates ReachabilityFlag0/1/2 per reachability pass, so this is direct observation of at least three GC reachability passes DURING which the object survived -- not merely 'nothing happened for 150 s'.

contrast.raw_RootSet_bit_write_LOG_0079: collected at t=60.0 s despite the bit being set
contrast.real_engine_root_path_this_run: survived the full 150 s window across >=3 observed reachability passes, then was collected 65 s after Release
contrast.conclusion: survival is attributable to the engine root path, not to timing
